title: TCL 55C745 (2023), device G08, model "Smart TV Pro", product G08_4K_GB, MediaTek tcl9618, 2.4 GB RAM.
notes:
TCL 55C745 (2023), device G08, model "Smart TV Pro", product G08_4K_GB, MediaTek tcl9618, 2.4 GB RAM.
Google TV, Android 14 (SDK 34), firmware UTT2.250416.001 AU02 - the same build as examples/tcl-q7c-google-tv
and examples/tcl-85rm7l-google-tv. Set up on Ethernet; France/UK household (French and UK catch-up apps
alongside Stremio and a third-party YouTube client).

Tested on one set, 21 October 2026. Disabled by hand with `pm disable-user --user 0`, one call each, in five
batches plus two follow-ups, with a screenshot after each batch. All 50 packages below survived two reboots.
launcherx and setupwraith were disabled afterwards, once the new launcher was confirmed as Home. YouTube
(via SmartTube), Live TV, the HDMI input list, the Source key QuickPanel, D-pad navigation and the physical
remote's Home/Input buttons were all checked.

Apply:   FORCE_SETUPWRAITH=1 TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/tcl-55c745/debloat.txt
FORCE_SETUPWRAITH=1 only on Ethernet with no saved Wi-Fi: disable.sh otherwise skips setupwraith
because it cannot see a Wi-Fi owner. On Wi-Fi, check `dumpsys wifi | grep cname` first (README).
launcherx is skipped by disable.sh's Home guard until the new launcher is Home; see README for order.
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/tcl-55c745/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx. Live TV / HDMI app: com.tcl.tv.
Left enabled on purpose: com.tcl.tv, com.tcl.tvinput, com.tcl.suspension (Input key/QuickPanel),
com.tcl.autopair (remote pairing), com.tcl.inputmethod.international (default keyboard), com.tcl.systemserver,
com.tcl.providers.config, com.tcl.initsetup, com.tcl.useragreement, com.tcl.globalkeyoverlay,
com.tcl.systemui.plugin, com.tcl.factory.view (never launch it either), com.google.android.katniss (voice
search, kept by owner's choice), com.tcl.miracast and com.tcl.magiconnectfree (mirroring, kept by owner's
choice), com.google.android.apps.mediashell (Chromecast), com.google.android.tv.remote.service, Play Store
and Play Services, all com.mediatek.* and com.dolby.* except AirPlay.
Not touched because what they do is unclear: com.tvos, com.tpa.kb (system-level agent: RECOVERY,
MASTER_CLEAR, CHANGE_COMPONENT_ENABLED_STATE permissions - do not disable), tv.mopa.ginga (broadcast
interactive-TV middleware), com.tcl.gallery (also TCL's screensavers), com.tcl.partnercustomizer,
com.tcl.interactive, com.tcl.ttvs.

Differs from examples/tcl-q7c-google-tv (same firmware build, different household): com.tcl.eva is disabled
here (tested fine, matches examples/tcl-g08-eu-android12; the Q7C list left it untouched over its camera/BI
permissions - no camera feature was exercised here either, so treat that as still unverified, just not
reverted); com.tcl.miracast and com.tcl.magiconnectfree are kept here (owner's choice, opposite of Q7C);
com.google.android.katniss is kept here (owner's choice, opposite of Q7C); stock YouTube and YouTube Music
are disabled here (owner uses a third-party YouTube client instead); Twitch and UK catch-up apps (ITVX,
My5, Wuaki/Rakuten TV) are disabled here by choice; French catch-up apps (France.tv, 6play, TF1+, Arte)
are kept here by choice, untested on the Q7C set.
